name: R5 Phase 2 decision rule (v5), written before any M1/M2a/M3/M4 result exists
baseline: v4 (REPRISE, frozen: scripts/iter3_eval.py sha256 40a9bf33..., entrance 0.40/0.30/0.10, m=2, LP k10 a0.9 g3 15 warm sweeps)

entrance_m1: E3m1@0.1 (neighbour rank m = 1, thresholds frozen from dev1 tuning in (2))

conditions: the 15 matched conditions per dev split (5 shot draws x 3 order seeds); draw-level means; 95% t interval over draws (4 d.o.f.)
primary: near FPR95 of the full score (x TINS where the candidate uses TINS)
selection_dev1: among candidates whose mean far FPR95 difference to v4 on dev1 is <= +0.5, the one with the lowest mean dev1 near FPR95; it must beat v4 on dev1 with the upper end of the 95% CI of the near FPR95 difference < 0
confirmation_dev2: the selected candidate must have the upper end of the 95% CI of the near FPR95 difference to v4 on dev2 < 0 and a mean far FPR95 difference <= +0.5
adoption: at most one modification; if confirmed, v5 = v4 + that modification (all other settings frozen); otherwise v5 is not defined and Phase 3 evaluates v4
not_decision_inputs: E1, E2-E5, sensitivity and oracle diagnostics (E5) are analyses only; test data are not used
